enchantment.dungeonsgear.anima_conduit.d: Each soul you absorb grants a small amount of health.
enchantment.dungeonsgear.enigma_resonato: Give a chance to inflict 50% more damage based on the amount of souls you have.
enchantment.dungeonsgear.gravity.desc: This effect pulls mobs in range towards the weapon's impact point.
enchantment.dungeonsgear.poison_cloud.de: Has a 30% chance to summon a poison cloud that deals damage to enemies in an area for three seconds.
enchantment.dungeonsgear.refreshment.des: Defeating a mob can turn a glass bottle in your inventory into a health potion.
enchantment.dungeonsgear.artifact_synerg: Whenever you use an artifact, your next attack deals bonus damage.
enchantment.dungeonsgear.freezing.desc: Slows mobs after hit for three seconds.
enchantment.dungeonsgear.busy_bee.desc: Chance to summon a bee after defeating a mob.
enchantment.dungeonsgear.chains.desc: Has a 30% chance to chain a cluster of mobs together and keep them bound for a short time.
enchantment.dungeonsgear.committed.desc: Deal increased damage against already wounded enemies.
enchantment.dungeonsgear.critical_hit.de: Gives you a chance to inflict non-standard critical hits.
enchantment.dungeonsgear.echo.desc: Every few seconds, your will attack twice.
enchantment.dungeonsgear.exploding.desc: Mobs explode after they are defeated.
enchantment.dungeonsgear.guarding_strike: When you defeat a mob, you are given a temporary shield that reduces damage by 50%.
enchantment.dungeonsgear.illagers_bane.d: Attacks deal extra damage to Illagers.
enchantment.dungeonsgear.leeching.desc: Defeating a mob heals you a small portion of the mob's max health.
enchantment.dungeonsgear.pain_cycle.desc: Attacking drains your life to grant one stack of Pain Cycle. At 5 stacks, your pain is channeled into your next attack.
enchantment.dungeonsgear.prospector.desc: Finds more emeralds and gold on fallen enemies.
enchantment.dungeonsgear.radiance.desc: Has a 20% chance to spawn a circular area that heals all allies within it.
enchantment.dungeonsgear.rampaging.desc: After defeating a mob, there is a small chance to increase your attack speed by 50% for a short time.
enchantment.dungeonsgear.rushdown.desc: After defeating a mob, increase your speed by 100% for a short time.
enchantment.dungeonsgear.shockwave.desc: A critical hit launches a shockwave, damaging enemies.
enchantment.dungeonsgear.soul_siphon.des: When you hit an enemy, gain a 10% chance to grant you a bunch of extra souls.
enchantment.dungeonsgear.thundering.desc: Has a 30% chance to summon a lightning strike that damages nearby enemies.
enchantment.dungeonsgear.weakening.desc: Your attacks decrease the attack damage of nearby enemies for five seconds.
enchantment.dungeonsgear.accelerate.desc: Increases charge speed for each consecutive shot. Resets one second after firing.
enchantment.dungeonsgear.bonus_shot.desc: Firing a shot also fires a second shot at a nearby enemy. The second shot has reduced damage.
enchantment.dungeonsgear.burst_bowstring: Shoots nearby mobs when you roll, costing one arrow per roll. Projectiles deal 40% of a charged shot's damage.
Has a chance to fire four arrows in all directions on impact.
enchantment.dungeonsgear.cooldown_shot.d: When you attack with a charged shot, artifact cooldowns are decreased.
Causes an explosion at the arrow's impact point.
enchantment.dungeonsgear.freezing_shot.d: Slows mobs after impact for three seconds.
enchantment.dungeonsgear.fuse_shot.desc: Every few shots explodes after impact, dealing damage to nearby enemies.
enchantment.dungeonsgear.gravity_shot.de: This effect pulls mobs in range towards the arrow's impact point.
enchantment.dungeonsgear.growing.desc: The fired shot grows in the air, dealing extra damage to distant targets.
enchantment.dungeonsgear.overcharge.desc: Continue to hold the ranged attack button to double, triple, or quadruple charge a bow, increasing its damage each time.
enchantment.dungeonsgear.radiance_shot.d: Has a 20% chance to spawn a circular area that heals all allies within it.
enchantment.dungeonsgear.replenish.desc: Chance to immediately replenish an arrow after shooting.
enchantment.dungeonsgear.ricochet.desc: Small chance for arrows to ricochet off mobs.
enchantment.dungeonsgear.supercharge.des: Charged shots deal more damage and have more pushback.
enchantment.dungeonsgear.swirling.desc: Critical hits become swirling attacks, damaging nearby enemies.
enchantment.dungeonsgear.tempo_theft.des: Steals a small amount of a mob's movement speed and gives it to you for four seconds.
enchantment.dungeonsgear.velocity.desc: Projectiles shot by this weapon move faster.
enchantment.dungeonsgear.bag_of_souls.de: Increases the maximum number of souls that can be carried.
enchantment.dungeonsgear.beast_boss.desc: Increases the amount of damage your summoned pets deal.
enchantment.dungeonsgear.beehive.desc: Chance to summon a bee when you get hit by an enemy.
enchantment.dungeonsgear.cowardice.desc: While you are at full HP, you deal increased ranged and melee damage.
enchantment.dungeonsgear.death_barter.de: The first amount of emeralds collected are stored and then spent to save the player from death.
enchantment.dungeonsgear.deflect.desc: Grants a small chance to deflect incoming projectiles.
enchantment.dungeonsgear.final_shout.des: When your health drops below 25%, automatically activates the first three artifacts in your inventory without cooldown.
enchantment.dungeonsgear.fortune_of_the_: Increases your luck, which boosts the chance that rare drops become unique.
enchantment.dungeonsgear.frenzied.desc: While you are at less than half health, your attack speed is increased.
When activating any artifact, you regain a small amount of health.
enchantment.dungeonsgear.life_boost.desc: Each time you respawn due to enemy interference, your maximum health permanently increases.
Provides a brief invulnerability when collecting XP orbs.
enchantment.dungeonsgear.reckless.desc: Your health is decreased by 60%, but your melee damage is increased.
enchantment.dungeonsgear.recycler.desc: Being hit by damage-inflicting projectiles will occasionally craft a small quiver of arrows.
enchantment.dungeonsgear.explorer.desc: For every one hundred blocks explored, you regain a small amount of health.
Chance to spawn emeralds with every block explored.
enchantment.dungeonsgear.dodge.desc: Small chance to avoid all damage.
enchantment.dungeonsgear.rush.desc: Increases movement speed for one second after taking damage.
enchantment.dungeonsgear.speed_synergy.d: When activating any artifact, you gain +20% movement speed for a short time.
enchantment.dungeonsgear.void_dodge.desc: Small chance to randomly teleport on hit, avoiding all damage.
enchantment.dungeonsgear.beast_burst.des: Using a healing potion causes an explosion at your summoned pets' locations, dealing damage to mobs around them.
enchantment.dungeonsgear.beast_surge.des: Using your health potion boosts your summoned pets' attack and movement speed for 10 seconds.
enchantment.dungeonsgear.cooldown.desc: Reduces the cool-down time between uses of your artifacts.
enchantment.dungeonsgear.fire_focus.desc: The fire damage you deal is increased.
enchantment.dungeonsgear.food_reserves.d: Whenever you use a healing potion, you also create random food items.
enchantment.dungeonsgear.lightning_focus: The lightning damage you deal is increased.
enchantment.dungeonsgear.poison_focus.de: The poison damage you deal is increased.
Whenever you use a healing potion, you take -80% damage for a short duration.
enchantment.dungeonsgear.soul_focus.desc: Increases the amount of soul damage you deal.
enchantment.dungeonsgear.altruistic.desc: Heals allies around you depending on how much damage you take.
enchantment.dungeonsgear.burning.desc: Every 0.5 seconds damages all nearby enemies.
enchantment.dungeonsgear.chilling.desc: Emits a blast every two seconds that reduces the movement and attack speed of nearby enemies for one second.
enchantment.dungeonsgear.gravity_pulse.d: A blast occurs every five seconds that pulls nearby enemies towards you.
enchantment.dungeonsgear.life_steal_aura: Passively increases life steal of nearby allies.
enchantment.dungeonsgear.melee_aura.desc: Passively increases melee attack damage of nearby allies.
enchantment.dungeonsgear.snowball.desc: Fires a snowball at a nearby enemy every few seconds, briefly stunning it.
enchantment.dungeonsgear.speed_aura.desc: Passively increases speed of nearby allies.
enchantment.dungeonsgear.potion_aura.des: Using a healing potion, will heal nearby allies as well.
lore.dungeonsgear.bonebow: The Bonebow is the pride of Pumpkin Pastures, crafted within the walls of their humble village.
lore.dungeonsgear.twin_bow: The Twin Bow is the champion of the hero who finds themselves outnumbered and alone.
lore.dungeonsgear.haunted_bow: What indescribable horror! The creeping tentacles of this bow reach for the unknowable Void.
lore.dungeonsgear.bow_of_lost_souls: This bow, made of cursed bones, strips the living of their very souls.
lore.dungeonsgear.nocturnal_bow: The souls bound to the bow guide the arrows to their targets and cause it to glow slightly.
lore.dungeonsgear.soul_bow: The Soul Bow shimmers with all the beauty and fury of an attacking Vex.
lore.dungeonsgear.shivering_bow: The Shivering Bow pierces even the most ancient ice and strikes a chill into the heart of any enemy.
lore.dungeonsgear.elite_power_bow: The secrets of the Elite Power Bow's construction have been lost without a trace.
lore.dungeonsgear.sabrewing: This bow, built for a long-lost champion, feels right in the hands of those who seek justice.
lore.dungeonsgear.power_bow: The question of what makes the Power Bow so powerful has puzzled the minds of learned folk for ages.
lore.dungeonsgear.guardian_bow: Forged from fossilized coral, the Guardian Bow is a remnant from sunken civilizations of lost ages.
lore.dungeonsgear.red_snake: The Red Snake radiates an explosive heat, making it a deadly fire risk in the dry, desert lands.
lore.dungeonsgear.longbow: The Longbow, crafted for hunting rather than battle, is still useful in a fight.
lore.dungeonsgear.hunters_promise: This enchanted bow deepens the bond between the hunter and their trusted animal companion.
lore.dungeonsgear.masters_bow: The bow preferred by the masters of archery across the Overworld, no matter how simple it appears.
lore.dungeonsgear.hunting_bow: This enchanted bow strengthens the bond between the hunter and their animal companion.
lore.dungeonsgear.ancient_bow: The Ancient Bow is still as sprightly as the day it was first strung.
lore.dungeonsgear.mechanical_shortbow: A brand new development in quick firing technology, this bow packs a swift punch.
lore.dungeonsgear.purple_storm: Named the Purple Storm after its lovely hue, this legendary bow packs a powerful punch.
lore.dungeonsgear.shortbow: The preferred weapon of thieves and rogues, the Shortbow is nimble and lethal at short range.
lore.dungeonsgear.love_spell_bow: Love can be magical, but when it becomes too powerful, it can turn into a frenzy.
lore.dungeonsgear.the_green_menace: The arrows fired from the Green Menace always hit their intended target, even in the thickest fog.
lore.dungeonsgear.the_pink_scoundrel: It would be a deadly mistake to underestimate the power of the Pink Scoundrel.
lore.dungeonsgear.trickbow: A sleek bow that seems to never miss its target.
lore.dungeonsgear.sugar_rush: This candy-colored bow has a surprising bitter bite.
lore.dungeonsgear.snow_bow: Those who face the Snow Bow in battle must also prepare to face the chill of freezing wintry winds.
lore.dungeonsgear.winters_touch: Arrows fired from this legendary bow are said to be carried by the winter winds themselves.
lore.dungeonsgear.echo_of_the_valley: This bow calls upon the twisting winds of the hidden valley where it was first strung.
lore.dungeonsgear.burst_gale_bow: A bow infused with the force of a rolling wind which can flare up in an instant.
lore.dungeonsgear.wind_bow: A mesmerizing bow that captures the power of the wind to fire mighty Gale Arrows.
lore.dungeonsgear.auto_crossbow: The Arch-Illager said the design for this powerful crossbow came to him in a vision.
lore.dungeonsgear.butterfly_crossbow: This crossbow moves faster than wings in flight and strikes down enemies before they see the bolt.
lore.dungeonsgear.rapid_crossbow: New reloading technology helps this crossbow fire more rapidly than those that came before it.
lore.dungeonsgear.azure_seeker: If the color blue had a sound, it would be shots fired by the Azure Seeker.
lore.dungeonsgear.the_slicer: The peak of mischievous Illager-engineering, the famous Slicer was designed to fire bolts that pierce through even the thickest of armor.
lore.dungeonsgear.heavy_crossbow: The weighted crossbow is a damage-dealing menace and a real threat from a ranged distance.
lore.dungeonsgear.doom_crossbow: Many thought that the Doom Crossbow was just a myth, but this time the rumors turned out to be true.
lore.dungeonsgear.slayer_crossbow: The Slayer Crossbow is the treasured heirloom of many legendary hunters.
lore.dungeonsgear.feral_soul_crossbow: If you listen closely you can hear the souls inside the crossbow, usually ridiculing you.
lore.dungeonsgear.voidcaller: This weapon calls out to souls that are trapped between this world and the next.
lore.dungeonsgear.soul_crossbow: The Soul Crossbow was crafted by the mysterious Evokers and Enchanters of the Woodland Mansions.
lore.dungeonsgear.harp_crossbow: Half musical instrument and fully deadly weapon, the Harp Crossbow is the life of the party.
lore.dungeonsgear.lightning_harp_crossbo: Adding electrical energy to this crossbow changed the firing sound dramatically.
lore.dungeonsgear.scatter_crossbow: This crossbow, modified to hold and fire multiple bolts, is also a half-decent musical instrument.
lore.dungeonsgear.firebolt_thrower: The Firebolt Thrower launches chaos in a chain reaction of exploding arrows.
lore.dungeonsgear.exploding_crossbow: The power of TNT fused with the latest in archery design resulted in this devastating crossbow.
lore.dungeonsgear.imploding_crossbow: The Imploding Crossbow has been magically fine-tuned to maximize the impact of the explosion.
lore.dungeonsgear.burst_crossbow: A tactical crossbow favored by warriors and hunters alike, the Burst Crossbow is a powerful tool for any hero.
lore.dungeonsgear.corrupted_crossbow: This crossbow has a subtle yet corrupting power that is suitable for thieves and nimble warriors alike.
lore.dungeonsgear.dual_crossbow: Dual crossbows are the perfect choice for a warrior with quick reflexes in a fast-paced battle.
lore.dungeonsgear.baby_crossbow: While some discuss the cute Baby Crossbows, these deadly weapons grow into heavy hitters.
lore.dungeonsgear.harpoon_crossbow: The Harpoon Crossbow shoots harpoons that cut through wind and water with devastating power.
lore.dungeonsgear.nautical_crossbow: Why harpoon one enemy when you can harpoon many!
lore.dungeonsgear.broadsword: Only those with the strength of a champion and the heart of a hero can carry this massive blade.
lore.dungeonsgear.heartstealer: Gifted to one of the Arch-Illager's most distinguished generals upon their conquest of the Squid Coast - this runeblade is infused with dark witchcraft.
lore.dungeonsgear.great_axeblade: A lucky blacksmith turned a workshop blunder into a battlefield wonder, fusing two weapons into something new.
lore.dungeonsgear.claymore: A massive sword that seems impossibly heavy yet rests easily in a just warrior's hands.
lore.dungeonsgear.frost_slayer: The legendary Frost Slayer returns to the battlefield only in the darkest and coldest days of winter.
lore.dungeonsgear.dancers_sword: Warriors who view battle as a dance with death prefer double-bladed swords.
lore.dungeonsgear.nameless_blade: This deadly blade's story was lost to the endless sands of time.
lore.dungeonsgear.cutlass: This curved blade, wielded by the warriors of the Squid Coast, requires a steady hand in battle.
lore.dungeonsgear.sparkler: The Sparkler lights up the party as it cuts through the darkness.
lore.dungeonsgear.fang_of_frost: These lauded daggers of the northern mountains are known to freeze their foes to solid ice.
lore.dungeonsgear.moon_dagger: These curved blades shine like the crescent moon on a dark night.
lore.dungeonsgear.dagger: Daggers are the weapon of cravens - or so folks say.
lore.dungeonsgear.shear_dagger: Even the simplest of farmers can wield these Shear Daggers with savage results.
lore.dungeonsgear.cursed_axe: This cursed, poisonous axe leaves their victims sick for years with just a single scratch.
lore.dungeonsgear.whirlwind: Whirlwind, forged during an epic windstorm, is a double-bladed axe that levitates slightly.
lore.dungeonsgear.double_axe: A devastating weapon fit for barbaric fighters.
lore.dungeonsgear.firebrand: Crafted in the blackest depths of the Fiery Forge and enchanted with fiery powers.
lore.dungeonsgear.highland_axe: Expertly crafted and a polished weapon of war, the Highland Axe also makes a daring backscratcher.
lore.dungeonsgear.nightmares_bite: The twin blades of Nightmare's Bite drip with deadly venom, still potent after all these years.
lore.dungeonsgear.the_last_laugh: Strange, distorted laughter seems to whisper from these menacing looking sickles.
lore.dungeonsgear.sickle: A ceremonial weapon that hails from the same region as the Desert Temple.
lore.dungeonsgear.eternal_knife: A disturbing aura surrounds this knife, as if it has existed for all time and will outlive us all.
lore.dungeonsgear.truthseeker: The warden of Highblock Keep kept this unpleasant blade by their side during interrogations.
lore.dungeonsgear.soul_knife: A ceremonial knife that uses magical energy to hold the wrath of souls inside its blade.
lore.dungeonsgear.frost_scythe: The Frost Scythe is an indestructible blade that is freezing to the touch and never seems to melt.
lore.dungeonsgear.jailors_scythe: This scythe belonged to the terror of Highblock Keep, the Jailor.
lore.dungeonsgear.soul_scythe: A cruel reaper of souls, the Soul Scythe is unsentimental in its work.
lore.dungeonsgear.battlestaff: The battlestaff is a perfectly balanced staff that is ready for any battle.
lore.dungeonsgear.battlestaff_of_terror: This staff overwhelms its target in battle to explosive effect.
lore.dungeonsgear.growing_staff: A staff that grows and shifts as it attacks, the Growing Staff is unpredictable and powerful.
lore.dungeonsgear.tempest_knife: This knife slices through enemies like the wind that cuts between the mountaintops.
lore.dungeonsgear.resolute_tempest_knife: Passed down by nomads who roam the mountain peaks, this knife has been used in countless battles.
lore.dungeonsgear.chill_gale_knife: Crafted from the never-melting ice atop the mountain peaks, this knife is forever icy to the touch.
lore.dungeonsgear.boneclub: Those who wield a Bone Club prefer a less-subtle approach to problem-solving.
lore.dungeonsgear.bone_cudgel: The Bone Cudgel is old enough to be considered an ancient treasure, but still menacing even by modern standards.
lore.dungeonsgear.anchor: Those strong enough to wield the Anchor in battle follow the tradition of legendary seafaring warriors.
lore.dungeonsgear.hawkbrand: The Hawkbrand is the legendary sword of proven warriors.
lore.dungeonsgear.sinister_sword: The Sinister Sword, drawn to those who face the spookiest of nights, cuts through the night with a howl.
lore.dungeonsgear.gauntlet: Gauntlets call back to an ancient style of hand to hand combat.
lore.dungeonsgear.fighters_binding: Made in the wilds beyond the mountains, these gauntlets have been worn by warriors for centuries.
lore.dungeonsgear.mauler: These claw-like weapons, wielded by ancient Illager soldiers, are savage in battle.
lore.dungeonsgear.soul_fist: Soul Fists are gauntlets clad with great gemstones, each containing a powerful soul.
lore.dungeonsgear.hammer_of_gravity: A hammer, embedded with a crystal that harnesses the power of gravity, that is incredibly powerful.
lore.dungeonsgear.stormlander: The Stormlander, enchanted with the power of the raging storm, is a treasure of the Illagers.
lore.dungeonsgear.great_hammer: Blacksmiths and soldiers alike use the Great Hammer for its strength in forging and in battle.
lore.dungeonsgear.dark_katana: A blade that will not rest until the battle has been won.
lore.dungeonsgear.masters_katana: The Master's Katana has existed throughout the ages, appearing to heroes at the right moment.
lore.dungeonsgear.katana: A blade fit for expert warriors and fighters, its blade is crafted to inflict precision damage.
lore.dungeonsgear.flail: This ancient weapon inflicts grave blunt damage to those who cannot evade the deadly metal ball.
lore.dungeonsgear.suns_grace: This mace, engraved with secret healing runes, grants powerful restorative powers.
lore.dungeonsgear.mace: The Mace is a brutal tool of war and what it lacks in finesse; it makes up for in power.
lore.dungeonsgear.rapier: The rapier, a nimble and narrow blade, strikes with quick ferocity.
lore.dungeonsgear.bee_stinger: The Bee Stinger, a swift blade inspired by a bee's barb, can draw friendly bees into the fray to fight alongside you.
lore.dungeonsgear.freezing_foil: This needle-like blade is cold to the touch and makes quick work of any cut.
lore.dungeonsgear.boots_of_swiftness: Boots blessed with enchantments to allow for swift movements. Useful in uncertain times such as these.
ability.dungeonsgear.boots_of_swiftness: Gives a short boost to movement speed.
lore.dungeonsgear.death_cap_mushroom: Eaten by daring warriors before battle, the Death Cap Mushroom drives fighters into a frenzy.
ability.dungeonsgear.death_cap_mushroom: Greatly increases attack and movement speed.
lore.dungeonsgear.golem_kit: Iron Golems have always protected the Villagers of the Overworld. Their numbers are dwindling as a result of the Arch-Illager's war.
ability.dungeonsgear.golem_kit: Summons an Iron Golem to aid you in battle.
lore.dungeonsgear.tasty_bone: You hear distant howling as you hold the Tasty Bone in your hand.
ability.dungeonsgear.tasty_bone: Summons a wolf to aid you in battle.
lore.dungeonsgear.wonderful_wheat: This item has the faint smell of an open field, baked bread, and freshly cut crops.
ability.dungeonsgear.wonderful_wheat: Summons a llama to aid you in battle.
lore.dungeonsgear.gong_of_weakening: The ancient gong, marked with the symbols of a nameless kingdom, feels safe in your hands but emits a menacing hum to those nearby.
ability.dungeonsgear.gong_of_weakening: Weakens enemies around you, decreasing their damage and defensive capabilities.
lore.dungeonsgear.lightning_rod: Crafted by Illager Geomancers, this item is enchanted with the power of a storming sky.
ability.dungeonsgear.lightning_rod: You can spend souls to attack nearby enemies with a lightning strike.
lore.dungeonsgear.iron_hide_amulet: The Iron Hide Amulet is both ancient and timeless. Sand mysteriously and endlessly slips through the cracks in the iron.
ability.dungeonsgear.iron_hide_amulet: Provides a major boost to defense for a short time.
lore.dungeonsgear.love_medallion: A spell radiates from this trinket, enchanting those nearby into a trance where they must protect the holder of the medallion at all costs.
ability.dungeonsgear.love_medallion: Turn up to three hostile mobs into allies for ten seconds before they disappear.
lore.dungeonsgear.ghost_cloak: The souls trapped within the Ghost Cloak are protective, but they radiate a sense of melancholy.
ability.dungeonsgear.ghost_cloak: Briefly gain Ghost Form, allowing you to move through mobs and absorb some damage.
lore.dungeonsgear.harvester: The Harvester siphons the souls of the dead, before releasing them into a cluster hex of power.
ability.dungeonsgear.harvester: When used, the Harvester releases souls in an explosion.
lore.dungeonsgear.shock_powder: Shock Powder is a reliable tool for those who wish to make a swift exit.
lore.dungeonsgear.corrupted_seeds: A pouch of poisonous, corrupted seeds which grow into spiky grapple vines, entangling and slowly draining the life from its victims
ability.dungeonsgear.corrupted_seeds: Grow grapple vines, which inflict poison.
lore.dungeonsgear.wind_horn: When the Wind Horn echoes throughout the forests of the Overworld the creatures of the night tremble with fear.
ability.dungeonsgear.wind_horn: Pushes enemies away from you and slows them briefly.
lore.dungeonsgear.soul_healer: The Soul Healer amulet is cold to the touch and trembles with the power of souls. It is a common sight among the Illagers of the Woodland Mansions.
ability.dungeonsgear.soul_healer: Heals the most injured ally nearby, including yourself.
lore.dungeonsgear.light_feather: No one knows what mysterious creature this feather came from, but it is as beautiful and powerful.
ability.dungeonsgear.light_feather: Lets you tumble through the air, stunning and pushing enemies back as you go.
lore.dungeonsgear.flaming_quiver: This quiver is filled with the deadliest of arrows.
ability.dungeonsgear.flaming_quiver: Turns the next 7 arrows you shoot into burning arrows.
lore.dungeonsgear.torment_quiver: The Torment Quiver radiates powerful energy drawn from the eternal source of the Undead.
ability.dungeonsgear.torment_quiver: Makes the next 3 arrows you shoot apply high knockback to mobs and pass through walls.
lore.dungeonsgear.totem_of_regeneration: This hand-crafted wooden figurine radiates a warmth like that of a crackling campfire, healing those who gather around it.
ability.dungeonsgear.totem_of_regenerati: A totem that creates a circular aura, healing you and your allies.
lore.dungeonsgear.totem_of_shielding: This totem radiates powerful energy that bursts forth as a protective shield around those near it.
ability.dungeonsgear.totem_of_shielding: This totem has mystical powers that shield those around it from projectiles.
lore.dungeonsgear.totem_of_soul_protecti: This totem radiates powerful protective magic.
ability.dungeonsgear.totem_of_soul_prote: Creates a space around the totem which, when you or allies die within it, revives the player.
lore.dungeonsgear.corrupted_beacon: The Corrupted Beacon holds immense power within. It waits for the moment to unleash its wrath.
ability.dungeonsgear.corrupted_beacon: Fires a high-powered beam that continuously damages mobs.
lore.dungeonsgear.buzzy_nest: Bee lovers and the bee-loved alike are fans of the Buzzy Nest, but don't be fooled by the cute bees within - they pack a powerful sting!
ability.dungeonsgear.buzzy_nest: When the Buzzy Nest is placed on the ground, bees who will fight beside you begin to spawn.
lore.dungeonsgear.enchanted_grass: Just as there are powerful heroes who answer the call to fight, there are powerful enchanted sheep who will join the fight when summoned.
ability.dungeonsgear.enchanted_grass: Randomly summons one of three sheep allies that can grant either speed, poison, or fire effects.
lore.dungeonsgear.corrupted_pumpkin: The Corrupted Pumpkin glows with supernatural power, illuminating even the darkest nights with its powerful beacon.
ability.dungeonsgear.corrupted_pumpkin: Fires a high-powered beam that continuously damages mobs.
lore.dungeonsgear.thundering_quiver: This copper quiver channels the power of lightning.
lore.dungeonsgear.harpoon_quiver: This quiver holds a number of harpoons that swiftly pierce through enemies on land or underwater.
lore.dungeonsgear.satchel_of_elixirs: The Satchel of Elixirs always contains the exact potions you need! (Well, at least the potions it thinks you need, which is still pretty helpful.)
ability.dungeonsgear.satchel_of_elixirs: Crafts two random potions and throws them on the ground near you.
lore.dungeonsgear.satchel_of_snacks: The Satchel of Snacks provides a treat when you need it the most!
ability.dungeonsgear.satchel_of_snacks: Crafts a random food item and throws it on the ground near you.
lore.dungeonsgear.satchel_of_elements: Mysteries surround this primordial satchel. Will it unleash fire, ice, or something a lot less nice?
ability.dungeonsgear.satchel_of_elements: Hits up to 7 nearby mobs with an elemental status effect: struck by lightning, frozen, or set ablaze.
lore.dungeonsgear.powershaker: The Powershaker is a smashing good time, though it may not be as fun for your enemies.
ability.dungeonsgear.powershaker: When Powershaker is activated, your next 3 melee attacks cause mobs to explode.
lore.dungeonsgear.updraft_tome: An ancient book filled with illegible glyphs, you feel a strange breeze as you flip the pages.
ability.dungeonsgear.updraft_tome: Launch up to 5 enemies into the air, stunning and damaging them.
lore.dungeonsgear.eye_of_the_guardian: The Eye of the Guardian holds a power that awakens in the hands of a worthy hero.
ability.dungeonsgear.eye_of_the_guardian: Fires a beam of energy that locks you into place as it deals damage to enemies in its path.
lore.dungeonsgear.fireworks_display: The Fireworks Display is often used by Villagers to celebrate a successful defense against an Illager raid, it is also quite handy as a flare for lost travellers.
ability.dungeonsgear.fireworks_display: Shoots a display of fireworks into the sky.
lore.dungeonsgear.soul_lantern: This lantern, still covered in the sands of a far-flung place, allows those who hold it to summon a creature formed from bound souls.
ability.dungeonsgear.soul_lantern: Summons a Soul Wizard to aid you in battle.
lore.dungeonsgear.battle_robes_armor: The Battle Robe is worn by the distinguished Illager Evokers of the Arch-Illager's court.
lore.dungeonsgear.champions_armor: Given to the champions of the Overworld by the free villagers as a token of their thanks for many years of protection and assistance. The mark of a true hero.
lore.dungeonsgear.heros_armor: Only given to the highest caliber of heroes, the Hero's Armor is a precious gift from the Villagers.
lore.dungeonsgear.dark_armor: Dark Armor, made in the blackest depths of the Fiery Forge, is worn by the Illager royal guard.
lore.dungeonsgear.titans_shroud_armor: The Titan's Shroud has passed through the hands of evil for generations.
lore.dungeonsgear.evocation_robes_armor: Potent magical runes are weaved into the fabric of these robes, their origins and powers are shrouded in mystery.
lore.dungeonsgear.ember_robes_armor: The Ember Robe was created by Illager Evokers to distinguish themselves from the common guard.
lore.dungeonsgear.grim_armor: Grim Armor invokes a sense of dread for the one who wears it and to those who face it in battle.
lore.dungeonsgear.wither_armor: Wither Armor, crafted with the parts of slain enemies, was made to terrify the wearer's enemies.
lore.dungeonsgear.guards_armor: Cheap armor made in bulk, the Guard's Armor is a common sight in the villages of the Overworld.
lore.dungeonsgear.curious_armor: No one knows where this strange armor came from but it seems familiar to you.
lore.dungeonsgear.mercenary_armor: Mercenary Armor, favored by those looking to save some coin, lacks flair but gets the job done.
lore.dungeonsgear.renegade_armor: Renegade Armor made a fine payment for mercenaries hired to protect the villages against Illagers.
lore.dungeonsgear.hungry_horror_armor: When you wear this cloak, the sounds of screams fill the air. But are the screams yours, or your enemies?
lore.dungeonsgear.ocelot_armor: You feel a rush of pure adrenaline surge through your body when you wear this Ocelot's pelt.
lore.dungeonsgear.shadow_walker_armor: The legendary black Ocelot was as graceful as it was deadly. When you wear its pelt, you feel like your enemies are left chasing your shadow.
lore.dungeonsgear.phantom_armor: This armor, crafted from the bones of Phantoms, is a terrifying sight on the battlefield.
lore.dungeonsgear.frost_bite_armor: Frost Bite remembers the icy winds which once flowed beneath the wings of the night Phantoms.
lore.dungeonsgear.plate_armor: Plate Armor turns the average soldier into a fortress but comes with reduced mobility.
lore.dungeonsgear.full_metal_armor: Full Metal Armor is destined for the great defenders of the Overworld.
lore.dungeonsgear.reinforced_mail_armor: Mostly worn by casual adventurers, Reinforced Mail is a common sight throughout the land.
lore.dungeonsgear.stalwart_armor: This reliable armor is sturdy enough to be passed down for generations.
lore.dungeonsgear.scale_mail_armor: This armor, crafted near the shores of a great sea, was inspired by the scales of fish.
lore.dungeonsgear.highland_armor: A wise armorer made this armor with care.
lore.dungeonsgear.snow_armor: A suit of armor that was tempered in snowmelt, protecting the wearer from the harsh cold of the tundra.
lore.dungeonsgear.frost_armor: This legendary armor, forged from ice that never melts, makes the wearer feel as if they are one with winter.
lore.dungeonsgear.soul_armor: In a particular light, the souls woven into the cloth of the Soul Robe shimmer with power.
lore.dungeonsgear.souldancer_armor: The Souldancer Robe comes alive in the light, as if the souls within are dancing for all eternity.
lore.dungeonsgear.spelunker_armor: The Spelunker Armor is worn by those who brave the darkest depths of the Overworld.
lore.dungeonsgear.cave_crawler_armor: The Cave Crawler armor has been passed down through generations of brave spelunkers and miners.
lore.dungeonsgear.thief_armor: This armor is light, nimble, and smells faintly of sulfur.
lore.dungeonsgear.spider_armor: Spider Armor, created by master thieves, is inspired by the agile talents of the Spider.
lore.dungeonsgear.wolf_armor: Many warriors wear the heads of wolves into battle to strike fear into the hearts of their enemies.
lore.dungeonsgear.fox_armor: Ancient Villager tribes created this armor to honor the fox, who is a great and agile warrior. This piece strikes terror into the hearts of many enemies as it has a reputation for being quite difficult to pierce.
lore.dungeonsgear.arctic_fox_armor: If you want to survive the icy tundra in style, the Arctic Fox Armor is the best choice this season.
lore.dungeonsgear.climbing_armor: This sturdy Climbing Gear is perfect for braving the blistering cold of the icy mountain face.
lore.dungeonsgear.rugged_climbing_armor: Take on the worst that nature can throw at you in this rugged armor.
lore.dungeonsgear.goat_armor: Made from the pelts of Mountain Goats, you'll feel like skipping from peak to peak in this Goat Gear.
lore.dungeonsgear.emerald_armor: As you wear the Emerald Armor during your adventures, it calls other emeralds to you as if by chance.
lore.dungeonsgear.gilded_glory_armor: Even death itself has to pause and admire the charms of the legendary Gilded Glory armor.
lore.dungeonsgear.opulent_armor: Opulent Armor, originally designed more for show than for combat, thrives in the presence of Emeralds.
lore.dungeonsgear.beenest_armor: There always seems to be a slight buzz around the Beenest Armor. Or maybe the buzz is coming from within?
lore.dungeonsgear.beehive_armor: The Beehive Armor hums with the focused power of countless bees.
